figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Superimposed images of the TS’s:
4,2TS3−4 (left) and
4,2TSIII−IV (right). The major difference on the EA pathway (left) from
that on the EH pathway(right) is the orientation of the substrate ring.
While the substrate in the doublet state (blue) is more inclined to the
porphyrin ring compared to the substrate in the quartet state (red) on
the EA pathway, the scenario on the EH pathway is much more
different.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 6
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 6. Alignment of the two transition states, namely, 2,4TS3−4 and
2,4TSIII−IV, on the EA and the EH pathways. On the left side is the TS
for the EA path, while the superimposed geometries on the right side
are the TS for the EH pathway. The red and blue colors indicate the
quartet and the doublet spin state, respectively.
